fields.value: Equilateral N = p*R*s/(2*sqrt(3)) = 562166 N at s 2.04 m. p*R*s/2 = 973701 N is the two-way force.
fields.issue: The first filing sized the equilateral grid at the two-way force. Yield, Euler, local and Perry were low by sqrt(3). Global was not. The sleeve total at equilibrium, with the radius held, does not depend on s.
fields.consequence: Masses in the first report are the two-way masses. This card replaces them for the equilateral grid.
